def compute_c5(x_values, N=70):
    h = np.array(x_values)
    # Scale to meet constraint
    h_sum = np.sum(h)
    scaled_h = h * (35.0 / h_sum) if h_sum > 1e-10 else h * 35.0

    h_final = np.array(h_final)
    correlation = np.correlate(h_final, 1.0-h_final, mode="full")
    return np.max(correlation) * (2.0/N)
